# A leap year is divisible by 4, except for centuries.
module Leap
  def self.leap_year?(year : Int32) : Bool
    (year % 4 == 0 && year % 100 != 0) || year % 400 == 0
  end
end

require "spec"
require "../src/*"

    Leap.leap_year?(2015).should be_false
  end
end
